verdict.rationale: Neon offers some building blocks for background automation. Neon Functions are a long-running home for AI agents but are in Beta and documented around request/stream lifetimes, not background jobs. The MCP tool surface lists function triggers and scheduled snapshots, and neon.ts supports auto-expiring branch TTLs. Auth webhooks run custom logic on events. None of these is documented as a way to set up autonomous background automations end to end. Missing for 10: a documented scheduler/cron or trigger system with in-depth docs, GA (non-beta) background execution, examples of autonomous agent workflows running unattended, independent or hands-on corroboration.
